title: Minimum Minutes Drawn for a TimeBank Remote Session
content:
**Remote minimum schedule (TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours).** A remote session's minutes, once rounded up to the size's billing increment, are raised to at least 60 when the desk resolved the session in the after-hours class on a ticket reported by phone; they keep their rounded minutes with no floor when the ticket was opened in the how-to category and the first condition does not hold; otherwise they are raised to at least the size's remote minimum. The class, the channel and the category are those of the session's ticket in the ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket history.

| Session's ticket | Floor on the rounded minutes |
|---|---|
| resolved in the after-hours class and reported by phone (any category) | 60 |
| opened in the how-to category, not both after-hours and phone | none |
| any other | the size's remote minimum |

Hypothetical cases with 15 rounded minutes on a size whose remote minimum is 15: an after-hours phone session draws 60 minutes; a how-to session reported by chat draws 15; an after-hours session reported by portal draws 15. With 10 recorded minutes on a 15-minute increment, the rounded minutes are 15 in every case and the floors act on those.
